text:
incident-bot: [INCIDENT] CRITICAL - eu-west inference pool showing multiple NotReady nodes and increased 5xx from runtime endpoints. Pager sent. root_ts: 1701234567
oncall-miguel: ACK. Checking cluster state and pods now.
sre-olivia: seeing spikes on observability: qps ~1.7x and 5xx ~12% for infer-edge routes.
ml-infra-jia: grabbed runtime logs, there are repeated GPU reset traces and CUDA OOMs around ~09:40 UTC.
oncall-miguel: quick commands:
```sh
kubectl get nodes -o wide | egrep -i 'NotReady|Ready'
# ip-10-0-4-12   NotReady  v1.26.x kubelet
# ip-10-0-4-13   NotReady  v1.26.x kubelet
kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide | grep runtime
```
oncall-miguel: ssh'd into ip-10-0-4-12, dmesg shows repeated GPU resets and NVRM Xid errors; kubelet is flapping.
sre-olivia: container runtime logs show "failed to start container: rpc error: code = Unavailable" then kubelet restart. Likely driver/device detach.
eng-runtime-ezra: that matches GPU driver/kernel hang leading to device detach -> kubelet churn. Recommend cordon+drain then replace instance.
oncall-miguel: cordoning both affected nodes: `kubectl cordon ip-10-0-4-12 && kubectl cordon ip-10-0-4-13` :white_check_mark:
sre-olivia: initiating best-effort drain: `kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data ip-10-0-4-12` etc. Routing fallback should steer traffic off.
eng-ramon: provisioning extra dedicated capacity and bumped autoscaler target +25% to absorb prefix load.
cs-ava: Customer GlobalMaps (ticket #7893) reporting latency and errors; asking if regional outage.
oncall-miguel: responding to CS: regional node instability, traffic being rerouted, mitigation in progress. ETA 60-120m for full stabilization.
ml-infra-jia: collecting diagnostics before any reboot: `sudo journalctl -u kubelet -n 300`, `dmesg | tail -n 200`, `nvidia-smi -q -d ERR`. Uploading to infra bucket.
ml-infra-jia: upload link: s3://infra-dumps/1701234567/gpu-ip-10-0-4-12.tgz (sha256:deadbeef...).
incident-bot: created incident record INC-2024-0091 assigned to eng-runtime.
oncall-miguel: attempted soft kubelet restart on 4-12, node returned Ready briefly then NotReady again after ~2m with gpu reset in kernel.
eng-runtime-ezra: do not keep cycling the node. Recommend cordon+drain (done) and reprovision/replace instance. Tag for hardware/driver diagnostics.
oncall-miguel: drain completed, cordon remains. Tagging instance: reprovision-required, reason: gpu-reset-loop.
sre-olivia: errors dropping to ~4% after routing fallback and added capacity. Monitoring closely; will escalate to eng-runtime on recurrence.
oncall-miguel: handing off monitoring to @sre-olivia: logs collected, nodes cordoned/drained, CS updated. /hand-off
sre-olivia: ACK takeover. Adding checklist to incident doc: logs path, reprovision flag, affected customers, follow-ups: stress test replacement, validate kernel/driver versions, consider vendor support if repeats, postmortem within 72h.
eng-runtime-ezra: plan: reprovision node, run GPU stress/driver burn-in on replacement before rejoin; prefer dedicated pool for critical tenants while we validate. If more nodes show similar failures, open vendor/driver ticket.
cs-ava: forwarding incident link INC-2024-0091 to customer contacts and will post status updates.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: degraded -> partial recovery after routing fallback and capacity bump. Incident remains open; next auto-update in 30m or on status change.
pagerduty: oncall-miguel acknowledged page; next oncall: sre-olivia.
oncall-miguel: attaching pod-level memory traces and kernel excerpts to INC-2024-0091. Observed correlated pod memory pressure preceding GPU reset on two pods.
sre-olivia: will continue monitoring dashboards and hand to next shift at 11:00 UTC if stable.
eng-ramon: if anyone spots the same Xid/gpu-reset pattern on other nodes, ping infra immediately so we can batch reprovisions.
eng-runtime-ezra: follow-up actions noted in incident: reprovision nodes, run stress/validation, pin or roll driver if needed, vendor escalation if multiple fails. Postmortem targeted in 72h.
